summary: Sync must resume from a real upstream cursor and propagate every failure (including a malformed page shape) rather than treating it as "no more data"; auto-refresh must not falsely advance freshness, and must run its internal GraphQL calls on an isolated cobra.Command rather than the invoking command (whose own --query/--variables flags, e.g. teach's unrelated required --query, must never leak into gqlExec's raw-override escape hatch). SearchApis must treat an empty query as "match everything".
reason: The generated sync loop wrote a wall-clock timestamp as its "cursor" (never resumable, never paginated past page one), swallowed hard fetch/decode failures (including a malformed pagination payload) into an always-success exit, and the auto-refresh hook advanced the local freshness marker without ever fetching anything. Auto-refresh's first fix pass also introduced a real cross-command bug: passing the actually-invoked cobra.Command into the internal sync calls let gqlExec's --query/--variables raw-override escape hatch pick up an unrelated invoking command's own flags (e.g. `teach --query "<question>"`), corrupting the internal GraphQL requests. The store's empty-query search path also short-circuited to zero rows instead of the full cache, breaking the default (unfiltered) export command.
validated_outcome: go test ./... green (new pagination/failure-propagation/freshness/empty-query regression coverage); go build, go vet, go mod tidy, govulncheck, and the SKILL.md verifier all pass.
